purpose: Contact-target-guided IK proposals after0/100 rotation and failed bounded joint trajectory search; privileged development diagnostic, no neural training or hardware
object_path: SO3 geodesic from actual prefix-end orientation to the unchanged measured +/-15deg task goal, fractions0.25/0.5/0.75/1; center fixed or linearly lifted3mm. Contact targets are the corresponding rigid transform of original anchors
contact_selection: Require loaded thumb_dp and middle_ip. Strongest positive-normal-force contact per required body, plus strongest contact per other finger if>=5percent object weight; maximum5 anchors. Virtual attached points at actual contact positions, not a force-closure guarantee
preload: Command target=prefix command+(IK actual-joint target-prefix actual joints). Bounds intersect original actual-joint ROM, +/-0.3rad and original command ROM after preload offset; no ROM enlargement or reset of inherited controller velocity
planning_isolation: New MjData for FK only; live qpos/qvel/time/controller/queue/camera/RNG/model signature must remain identical before/after all fits. Hypothetical geometry, positions and normal targets never enter live physics. Compiled pinned model has16 controlled finger hinges and one fixed-wrist equality; reject unsupported passive hinges
physical_budget: Per state: one physical prefix-only planning preparation, one zero-offset7s reference and four separately executed7s IK proposals. Three states=>18 maximum preparations/rollouts,15 full continuations. No retries, success filtering, snapshots, or extra replay
rollout: Every case independently executes original6.5s reach, one release and7s frozen grasp. All six prefixes per state must match. Interpolate command knots quintically, hold final target5..7s; original16D actions, braking speed/acceleration, delays and invalid-observation behavior. Keep all2ms audits and failures
nonconverged_fits: Record optimizer status/residuals and physically test finite bounded proposals even if IK does not converge. Nonfinite or invalid-bound proposals are skipped as failures without refit or extra budget
quality: Unmodified15deg/140tick environment and final1s fullSO3<8deg, loaded opposition, velocities,2deg/2mm spans and original hard gates. All conditions/states retained, no winner chosen to tune other states or formal seeds
logging: Every action logs original296D observation,16D action, command, full qpos/qvel/time for later faithful geometry visualization, contact data and original task information
limits: Previously seen development states, positive direction only, privileged contact/joint truth for planning. No independent100-case, continuous rotation or sim2real acceptance credit; no automatic PPO/BC or budget extension
